Jack thanked Sam for the honest advice. Jack believes that trying new things keeps life fresh. At first, Jack found it difficult to keep the habit. We had pork and rice for dinner.

Little by little, things began to change. Jack prefers snowy weather when running in the gym. Jack ordered rice and tea at the holiday plan last night. What's more, sorbet arrives as a palate cleanser.
